svg.text: Paths: the order each regime did things, ignoring the calendar
Consecutive repeats collapsed. Right column: similarity of each regime's opening to frontier AI's path so far (1 = identical, 0 = nothing shared).

g.data-tip: Financial statement audit: mandate. 1844 UK Joint Stock Companies Act requires audited balance sheets; auditors need not be accountants.
Financial statement audit: rollback. 1856 Mandatory audit repealed; audit becomes voluntary for most companies.
Financial statement audit: voluntary. 1880 ICAEW chartered; audits voluntary in the UK between 1856 and 1900.

Financial statement audit: mandate. 1900 UK Companies Act 1900 restores mandatory annual audit. | 1933 US Securities Act and 1934 Exchange Act require independent audits for listed companies after the 1929 crash.
Financial statement audit: access/publication. 1934 Audited financial statements filed publicly with the SEC.
Financial statement audit: trigger. 1938 McKesson & Robbins fraud: auditors had not verified inventory or receivables.
Financial statement audit: standards. 1939 First Statements on Auditing Procedure: physical inventory observation and receivables confirmation become required.
Financial statement audit: delegation. 1990 Audit firms' consulting revenue from audit clients overtakes audit fees at large firms.
Financial statement audit: trigger. 2001 Enron collapse; Arthur Andersen had provided audit and consulting services to the same client.
Financial statement audit: oversight. 2002 PCAOB registers and inspects audit firms.

Financial statement audit: independence. 2002 Sarbanes-Oxley: PCAOB created to inspect auditors; audit and most consulting separated; lead partner rotation every five years; audit committee independence. | 2014 EU audit reform: mandatory firm rotation and a cap on non-audit fees for public-interest entities.
Ship classification: voluntary. 1760 Lloyd's Register begins as an underwriters' register of ship condition.
Ship classification: oversight. 1968 IACS founded to harmonize class societies.
Ship classification: trigger. 1999 Erika sinks after changing class; 2002 Prestige sinks.
Ship classification: independence. 2009 EU Regulation 391/2009 sets recognition and independence rules for classification societies acting for flag states.
Boilers and pressure vessels: voluntary. 1866 Hartford Steam Boiler founded: insurance conditioned on inspection.
Boilers and pressure vessels: trigger. 1905 Grover Shoe Factory boiler explosion kills 58.
Boilers and pressure vessels: mandate. 1908 Massachusetts enacts the first state boiler law.
Boilers and pressure vessels: standards. 1914 First ASME Boiler Code published.
Boilers and pressure vessels: oversight. 1919 National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspectors commissions inspectors across jurisdictions.
Electrical and consumer product safety: voluntary. 1894 Underwriters Laboratories founded after electrical fires at the 1893 Chicago World's Fair; insurer-linked at origin.
Electrical and consumer product safety: standards. 1903 UL publishes its first standard (tin-clad fire doors).
Electrical and consumer product safety: mandate. 1972 Consumer Product Safety Act creates the CPSC.
Electrical and consumer product safety: oversight. 1988 OSHA Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratory program accredits third-party labs, ending single-lab dominance.
Electrical and consumer product safety: trigger. 2007 Lead-paint toy recalls.
Electrical and consumer product safety: mandate. 2008 CPSIA requires third-party testing of children's products by CPSC-accepted laboratories.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: mandate. 1906 Pure Food and Drug Act: labeling and adulteration rules.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: trigger. 1937 Elixir sulfanilamide kills more than 100 people.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: mandate. 1938 Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act: pre-market safety review.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: trigger. 1961 Thalidomide birth defects.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: delegation. 1962 Sponsors design and run the efficacy trials the regulator reviews; contract research organizations grow from the 1970s.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: mandate. 1962 Kefauver-Harris Amendment: proof of efficacy, controlled trials, informed consent.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: standards. 1962 Adequate and well-controlled trials required as the evidentiary standard.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: trigger. 1976 Industrial Bio-Test Laboratories found to have falsified safety studies for hundreds of products.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: oversight. 1978 Good Laboratory Practice regulations govern the conduct and inspection of nonclinical testing labs.
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: payer shift. 1992 PDUFA: sponsors pay user fees that fund FDA review (payment moves toward the assessed party).
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: independence. 1998 FDA rule on financial disclosure by clinical investigators (21 CFR Part 54).
Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy: access/publication. 2007 FDAAA mandates trial registration and results reporting on ClinicalTrials.gov.
Aircraft certification: mandate. 1926 Air Commerce Act: federal certification of aircraft and pilots.
Aircraft certification: trigger. 1956 Grand Canyon mid-air collision.
Aircraft certification: mandate. 1958 Federal Aviation Act creates the FAA.
Aircraft certification: standards. 1965 Federal Aviation Regulations codified.
Aircraft certification: delegation. 2005 Organization Designation Authorization lets manufacturers' employees perform certification work.
Aircraft certification: trigger. 2018 Boeing 737 MAX crashes (2018, 2019).
Aircraft certification: independence. 2020 Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act: FAA approval of ODA unit members, expanded whistleblower protection, limits on delegation.
Credit rating agencies: voluntary. 1909 Moody's publishes the first bond ratings, sold to investors by subscription.
Credit rating agencies: delegation. 1970 Issuer-pays model makes the rated party the client.
Credit rating agencies: trigger. 1970 Penn Central default; agencies begin charging issuers rather than investors.
Credit rating agencies: oversight. 1975 SEC creates the NRSRO designation, embedding ratings in regulation. | 2006 Credit Rating Agency Reform Act formalizes NRSRO registration and SEC oversight.
Credit rating agencies: trigger. 2008 Structured-finance ratings fail in the financial crisis.
Credit rating agencies: independence. 2010 Dodd-Frank Title IX: SEC Office of Credit Ratings, methodology disclosure, analyst separation from sales, expanded liability exposure.
Nuclear safety and safeguards: mandate. 1957 IAEA established.
Nuclear safety and safeguards: access/publication. 1970 NPT safeguards agreements give the IAEA inspection rights in signatory states.
Nuclear safety and safeguards: independence. 1974 Energy Reorganization Act splits the AEC into the NRC (regulation) and ERDA (promotion).
Nuclear safety and safeguards: access/publication. 1978 NRC resident inspector program places regulator staff permanently on site at every operating plant.
Nuclear safety and safeguards: voluntary. 1979 INPO founded: industry-funded peer evaluations with confidential reports tied to insurance.
Nuclear safety and safeguards: trigger. 1979 Three Mile Island accident. | 1991 Iraq's undeclared program discovered after the Gulf War.
Nuclear safety and safeguards: access/publication. 1997 Additional Protocol expands IAEA access to undeclared sites and information.
Automobile crash safety: voluntary. 1959 Insurance Institute for Highway Safety founded by insurers.
Automobile crash safety: trigger. 1965 Unsafe at Any Speed and congressional hearings on auto safety.
Automobile crash safety: mandate. 1966 National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act; NHTSA formed 1970.
Automobile crash safety: standards. 1967 First Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards.
Automobile crash safety: access/publication. 1979 NCAP publishes comparative crash ratings. | 1995 IIHS begins publishing its own crash test ratings.
Food safety: mandate. 1906 Federal Meat Inspection Act.
Food safety: trigger. 1993 Jack in the Box E. coli outbreak.
Food safety: mandate. 1996 HACCP rule for meat and poultry.
Food safety: voluntary. 2000 Global Food Safety Initiative benchmarks private certification schemes.
Food safety: trigger. 2008 Melamine adulteration in China.
Food safety: oversight. 2011 FSMA authorizes FDA accreditation of third-party certification bodies.
Cybersecurity assurance: standards. 1985 TCSEC (Orange Book): government evaluation of trusted systems.
Cybersecurity assurance: oversight. 1999 Common Criteria (ISO/IEC 15408) with accredited commercial evaluation labs.
Cybersecurity assurance: mandate. 2004 PCI DSS: card networks require assessments by Qualified Security Assessors.
Cybersecurity assurance: oversight. 2011 FedRAMP accredits third-party assessment organizations for cloud services.
Cybersecurity assurance: trigger. 2013 Target breach at a PCI-compliant merchant.
Sustainability (ESG) reporting assurance: standards. 1997 Global Reporting Initiative founded; voluntary reporting framework.
Sustainability (ESG) reporting assurance: voluntary. 2003 AA1000 Assurance Standard published; voluntary third-party assurance spreads.
Sustainability (ESG) reporting assurance: trigger. 2015 Volkswagen emissions scandal undermines self-reported environmental claims.
Sustainability (ESG) reporting assurance: mandate. 2022 EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive requires limited assurance, phasing in from 2024.
Sustainability (ESG) reporting assurance: standards. 2024 ISSA 5000 assurance standard issued.
Dietary supplements (US): rollback. 1994 DSHEA removes pre-market approval for supplements.
Dietary supplements (US): voluntary. 2001 USP launches a voluntary supplement verification program.
Dietary supplements (US): trigger. 2003 Ephedra-linked deaths, including a professional athlete.
Dietary supplements (US): access/publication. 2006 Dietary Supplement and Nonprescription Drug Consumer Protection Act requires serious adverse event reporting.
Dietary supplements (US): standards. 2007 FDA current good manufacturing practice rule for supplements.
Crypto exchange proof of reserves: voluntary. 2014 Exchanges begin publishing proof-of-reserve attestations.
Crypto exchange proof of reserves: trigger. 2014 Mt. Gox collapse.
Crypto exchange proof of reserves: rollback. 2022 Accounting firms pause or withdraw proof-of-reserves work for crypto clients.
Crypto exchange proof of reserves: trigger. 2022 FTX collapse; a prior attestation had not covered liabilities.
Crypto exchange proof of reserves: mandate. 2023 EU MiCA imposes safeguarding and reporting duties on crypto-asset service providers, applying from 2024.
Platform and hiring-algorithm audits: trigger. 2018 Cambridge Analytica revelations.

Platform and hiring-algorithm audits: mandate. 2021 NYC Local Law 144 requires bias audits of automated employment decision tools (effective 2023). | 2022 EU Digital Services Act Article 37 requires annual independent audits of very large platforms.
Platform and hiring-algorithm audits: access/publication. 2022 DSA Article 40 grants vetted researchers data access to very large platforms.
Platform and hiring-algorithm audits: independence. 2023 DSA delegated regulation on audits: auditor independence, limits on prior non-audit services, rotation.
Platform and hiring-algorithm audits: trigger. 2025 Published analysis of 116 LL144 bias audits finds shallow and inconsistent audits.
Frontier AI evaluation: voluntary. 2022 ARC Evals (later METR) tests GPT-4 pre-release; reported in the 2023 system card. | 2023 White House voluntary commitments; UK AI Safety Institute founded.
Frontier AI evaluation: delegation. 2023 Labs run their own safety evaluations and select, scope, and pay the external testers cited in system cards.
Frontier AI evaluation: voluntary. 2024 US AISI signs pre-deployment MOUs with OpenAI and Anthropic.
Frontier AI evaluation: trigger. 2025 FrontierMath funding disclosure failure.
Frontier AI evaluation: standards. 2025 AEF-1 (AI Evaluator Forum) published in December: minimum operating conditions for independent evaluation.

Frontier AI evaluation: access/publication. 2025 EU Code of Practice: at least 20 business days and minimally guardrailed versions for external evaluators (voluntary code supporting the AI Act; enforceable obligations land August 2026).
Frontier AI evaluation: trigger. 2026 OpenAI agent swarm breaches Hugging Face; first on-site third-party incident investigation.

Frontier AI evaluation: mandate. 2026 Illinois SB 315 mandates annual independent audits from 2028 and bars the auditor and developer from holding a financial interest in each other (a financial-audit-style independence test embedded in the mandate).
Frontier AI evaluation: access/publication. 2026 Anthropic and OpenAI pledge embedded evaluators with employee-level access and publication rights.
